error.publishBlocked: The activity has errors that must be fixed or explained before it can be published.
error.publishedSaveBlocked: The activity is published, and some errors have no explanation that holds, so your changes are not saved. Fix the errors and save again. An error that is also in the published version (an explanation holds for 14 days) can be explained with “Explain again” under “Check and publish” on the activity’s page in HVL Interaktiv. An error that is new in your change can only be explained when you publish: return the activity to draft with “Return to draft” there, save, and then publish it with an explanation.

editor.title: Edit activity
editor.blockedErrors: Errors that must be fixed or explained: {{count}}.

An error that is also in the published version (an explanation holds for 14 days) can be explained with “Explain again” under “Check and publish”. editor.blockedSaveCanvas: The activity is published, and some errors have no explanation that holds, so your changes are not saved. Fix the errors listed below and save again. formativeUse.title: For formative use
formativeUse.body: H5P activities are scored in the browser. The points are meant for learning along the way (formative assessment), not for exams or grades.
formativeUse.dismiss: Do not show this notice again

dialog.title: This change resets students’ progress
dialog.body: Structural changes, such as adding, removing or reordering questions or answer options, reset the progress students have saved in the activity. Rewording an answer option also changes what the saved choices mean.
dialog.saveAsCopyHint: The new version is a private draft. The original and the students’ progress stay unchanged.
dialog.canvasPointer: In Canvas you can only reset the progress or cancel. To save the change as a new version instead, open the activity in the HVL Interaktiv portal and save it there.

outcome.resetAndSaved: The change is saved, and the students’ progress is reset.
outcome.savedAsCopy: The change is saved as a new version. The original and the students’ progress are unchanged.

safeEditing.resetNeededCanvas: This change alters the structure of the activity, and others have saved progress in it. Confirm that their progress should be reset, or cancel. You can save a new version in the HVL Interaktiv portal.
